name: Bretazenil
effects: lower euphoria and abuse potential vs full agonists
can precipitate withdrawal in BZD-tolerant patients

mechanismOfAction.summary: Non-selective GABA-A BZD-site partial agonist (~35–58% intrinsic efficacy vs full agonist); wide therapeutic window with reduced tolerance/dependence potential compared to full agonists.
mechanismOfAction.description: Imidazo[1,2-a]-pyrrolo[2,3-d]-benzodiazepine; partial agonist at BZD binding site across α1–α6 subunit-containing GABA-A receptors (~35–58% maximal efficacy). Can precipitate withdrawal in BZD-tolerant users by occupying the site without full agonism. Never marketed. Potency: 0.5 mg ≈ 10 mg diazepam (psychomotor impairment studies). t½ ~2–4.5 h across multiple human PK studies.
